feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 4 June 2026 4:13pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Thursday, 04 June 2026 at 4:15pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Transient ridge of high pressure approaching from the west with a deepening area of low pressure in the mid-Atlantic.


##Wind##

West 5 or 6, backing west or southwest 4 or 5 tomorrow morning, backing south or southwest later and occasionally 3 in the east.


##State of Sea##

Mainly moderate, becoming slight or moderate later.


##Weather##

Showers becoming isolated.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in showers.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South 5 or 6, but south or southeast 3 or 4 in the east of the area at first, backing southeast 5 to 7 in all waters overnight into Saturday, veering west or southwest 3 to 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, building rough in the south for a time.


##Weather##

Mainly fair to start, then rain or drizzle arriving overnight.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle.
